title: VPN down and new monitor
body:
The VPN is down for me since this morning. FortiClient shows "Unable to establish the VPN connection (-14)" right after I enter my credentials, so I can't reach the ERP or any file share from home. I've restarted the laptop and my router.

Also, unrelated, I need a new monitor: the one at my office desk has a flickering green line on the left side.
